node.statement: For that arbitrary instance, lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope applies without conflating its two error scales: P_X is a c0*epsilon-projection for each nonempty X among U,V,R; A_X is an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra; and, for U subseteq R (and V=R minus U), all relevant subordination and complementarity errors among P_U,P_V,P_R are at most L^0*epsilon. Moreover A_R may be recorded as an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra at epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, and all those direct-envelope errors are at most t_3.
